main_text.l: In fausto omine, futurum eius casum indica-bat.

Cum vero Constantiam Ioannes hic Pontifex peruenisset, eius atq; Imperatoris, et aliorum Christianorum principum consensu, concilium incepit generale, anno Domini 1414. In vigilia natalis Christi illuc accessit Imperator Sigismundus: & in eius noctis prima missa, Euangelium ut diaconus cantauit, Exijt edictum à Cæsare Augusto, &c. cumq; sedissent in concilio, præsente Sigismundo, cunctisq; data libertate loquendi, plus quam quadraginta crimina, & quidem gravissima, Papæ Ioannis obiecta sunt, ac probata: & quod Alexandrum prædecessorem, conducto Marsilio Parmen-si medico, per venenum suffulisset. Coactum est igitur, dictante Concilio, Papatu se abdicare: propterea quod esset hæreticus, simoniacus, mendax, hypocrita, homicida, veneficus, aleator, adulter, sodomita, & quid non? Quamobrem mutato statim habitu, fugere clanculum cœpit 21. die Martij sequenti, ad Scaphusam Austriæ urbem, & inde Friburgum. Sed curante ipso concilio 29. page.notes: Lines are fairly clear. Doubtful readings: "suffulisset" (printed "fuffulisset"), "Parmen-si" hyphenation, and "Heidelbergae" (printed "Heidelberge"). The catchword "latini" completes the hyphenated word "Pa-latini" and is therefore not repeated in the text. The "æ" ligatures were kept as printed. Long s was read as plain s throughout.
